![MacroForge — every macro checked, sorted, never lost](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/thumbnail.png)

  [![CurseForge](https://img.shields.io/badge/CurseForge-MacroForge-F16436?style=for-the-badge)](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/macroforge)
  ![Retail 12.1.0](https://img.shields.io/badge/Retail-12.1.0-148EFF?style=for-the-badge)
  ![WoW Forever 1.60.1](https://img.shields.io/badge/WoW%20Forever-1.60.1-FFD700?style=for-the-badge)
  ![MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-44CC88?style=for-the-badge)

## Your macro is broken. You will find out mid-pull.

No syntax check. No spell verification. No history. Blizzard's macro frame is a text box, and it has been for twenty years.

**MacroForge is the editor that should have shipped with the game.** It checks every line as you type, tells you what your macro would do *right now*, keeps every version you ever saved, and swaps whole macro sets when you change spec — without emptying your action bars.

![Editor: code, analysis and detected spells](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/shots/editor.png)

---

## It catches the mistake before the boss does

- **Live analysis** — every command, condition and spell checked against your own spellbook
- **"Did you mean…?"** — `/csatsequence` becomes `/castsequence`, a misspelt spell gets the closest match
- **Plain-language explanation** of every line, right next to the code
- **One-click fixes** — click an issue to jump to its line, click **Fix** to correct a mistyped command
- **Live test** — one click and the panel shows which clause fires right now, on which target, and follows as you change target, hover a unit or hold Shift
- **Live 255-character counter**, with the shortener one click away

## One window, built for speed

Everything opens inside it: templates, history, sharing and duplicates are pages of the window (`Esc` goes back), and the spell list, commands, condition builder and icon picker slide in next to the code. Search by name **or content**. Filter to what is broken, what sits on a bar, what nobody uses. Drag a macro straight onto your action bars. Right-click for duplicate, share, move between Character and Account, or its full history.

`Ctrl+S` save · `Ctrl+Z` undo · `Ctrl+F` search · `↑ ↓` walk the list · `Del` delete

![The MacroForge window](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/shots/window.png)

![Icon picker next to the code](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/shots/drawer.png)

## Your macros follow your spec

Save your character macros as a **set** — Raid, M+, PvP, whatever you run. Bind it to a spec. Change spec, and the right set is in place before the pull. Macros that exist in both sets **keep their action bar slots**, and anything you changed is saved into the set before it swaps.

![Sets bound to specs](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/shots/sets.png)

## Nothing is ever lost

- **Every version of every macro** is kept — including the edits you make in Blizzard's own frame
- Deleted a macro? It is in the **Trash**, body intact, one click from coming back
- **Automatic backup** before every set swap or restore
- Unsaved changes are marked, and MacroForge asks before dropping them

![Trash: recreate a deleted macro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/shots/trash.png)

## Also in the box

**190 templates** — stances, traps, totems, seals, curses, druid forms, focus interrupts, mouseover heals: 11 for every class and 16 to 21 per class on WoW Forever, every spell checked in the client. Browse any class, not only yours. Spell names are resolved from spell IDs, so they are always in the client's language.

**Audit** — one panel listing every macro that needs attention, worst first.

**Share** — export a macro as a short code, send it to another MacroForge user in game, or paste any macro copied from a guide: it is named for you.

**Condition builder** — build `[@mouseover,harm,nodead]` from menus instead of memorising it.

**Your language** — the whole addon, analysis and explanations included, follows your client's language:

![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/gb.png) English · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/fr.png) Français · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/de.png) Deutsch · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/es.png) Español · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/mx.png) Español (México) · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/it.png) Italiano · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/br.png) Português (Brasil) · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/ru.png) Русский · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/kr.png) 한국어 · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/cn.png) 简体中文 · ![](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/flags/tw.png) 繁體中文

**Blizzard's /macro window** gets a MacroForge button: the macro you selected there opens here.

![Templates of every class](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/shots/templates.png)

![The MacroForge button in /macro](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kriffin/MacroForge/main/docs/assets/shots/macroframe.png)

---

## Install

**With the CurseForge app** — search for *MacroForge*, or use the [project page](https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/macroforge).

**By hand** — download a [release](https://github.com/kriffin/MacroForge/releases) and drop the `MacroForge` folder into:

```
World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/        # Retail 12.x
World of Warcraft/_forever_/Interface/AddOns/  # WoW Forever
```

Then type `/mf` in game, or click the minimap button.

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| `/mf` | Open / close MacroForge |
| `/mf sets` | Macro sets |
| `/mf audit` | Check every macro |
| `/mf templates` | Class templates |
| `/mf import` · `/mf export` | Share codes |
| `/mf backups` · `/mf restore [n]` | Backups |
| `/mf trash` | Deleted macros |
| `/mf history` | Versions of the open macro |
| `/mf log [n]` · `/mf debug` | Debug log |
| `/mf help` | Everything else |

---

## Development

```bash
git clone https://github.com/kriffin/MacroForge.git
ln -s "$PWD/MacroForge" "/path/to/World of Warcraft/_retail_/Interface/AddOns/MacroForge"
bash tests/run.sh          # headless tests against a fake WoW API
luac -p $(git ls-files '*.lua')
```

| Path | |
|---|---|
| `Core.lua` | addon bootstrap, AceDB, slash commands, out-of-combat queue |
| `UI.lua` | main window: tabs, macro list, home and detail views |
| `Editor.lua` | editor pane: toolbar, code box, analysis, undo/redo |
| `Profiles.lua` | macro read/write, sets, backups |
| `History.lua` | revisions and trash |
| `Analyzer.lua` · `AnalyzerExplain.lua` | validation and explanations |
| `Templates.lua` · `Builder.lua` · `Share.lua` | templates, condition builder, share codes |
| `tests/` | fake WoW API + 11 headless tests |
| `docs/CURSEFORGE.md` | source of the CurseForge project page |

CI runs the syntax check, the tests, luacheck and a locale-key check on every push. Tagging `vX.Y.Z` builds the zip with the BigWigs packager and publishes it.

Built on [Ace3](https://www.wowace.com/projects/ace3), [LibDeflate](https://github.com/SafeteeWoW/LibDeflate), LibDataBroker + LibDBIcon and LibSharedMedia.

[MIT](https://github.com/kriffin/MacroForge/blob/main/LICENSE) — use it, fork it, improve it.

releases.notes:
Templates ready for the WoW Forever launch.

- **Every Forever template checked against the launch class changes**
  (236 spells, 9 classes, Blizzard's notes of 2–3 November and the 70755
  client data). Fixed: the paladin templates follow
  the launch class changes. "Seal & Judge" and "Crusader" cast Judgement and
  re-apply the Seal on Shift (Judgement no longer consumes the Seal on WoW
  Forever, so the old Seal-then-Judgement sequence wasted a press and the
  mana every other time). "Salvation" is "Sacrifice" now: Blessing of
  Salvation left the game on 30 October. Warrior "AoE" casts Thunder Clap
  from Defensive Stance too (it only needed Battle Stance before). Warlock
  "DoTs" is Corruption with Bane of Agony on Shift, and "Curses" offers
  Weakness, Tongues and Recklessness: Agony is a Bane now and stacks with a
  Curse. Shaman "Totems" drops its totem sequence (two Earth totems
  overwrote each other) for Call of the Elements, Totemic Recall on Shift
  and the new Totemic Call on Ctrl. Priest "Shadow" adds Devouring Plague
  (every race learns it now) and "Buffs" adds Divine Spirit on Ctrl.
- **New template**: druid "Revive" (mouseover, Rebirth in combat; Revive is
  a trainer spell on WoW Forever).
- **Retail game versions**: 12.1.5 and 12.1.7 (the TOC listed 12.0.1, 12.0.5
  and 12.1.0).
- **Dev tools**: `tools/bridge.sh` and `tools/read-logs.sh` default to the
  live `_forever_` install (the beta folder is empty since launch), and
  `tools/check-template-spells.lua` checks every spell ID of the Forever
  templates against the running client:
  `tools/bridge.sh -f tools/check-template-spells.lua`.
- **Analysis**: `!Forme d’ours` (the `!` that keeps a form from toggling
  off) is read as the spell "Forme d’ours" instead of an unverified name.
- **Dev bridge** (`tools/bridge.sh`): since client build 70338 (WoW Forever
  beta, 2026-10-10) `ReloadUI()` from addon code is ADDON_ACTION_BLOCKED,
  so the second key press is what writes the result; it comes after 90 s
  now. The SavedVariables file is found without `ls` (eza quotes paths with
  spaces, which made every query end in "no result").

The "?" icon stays automatic when you save.

- **Saving no longer freezes the icon** of a `#showtooltip` macro on the
  spell it showed at that moment. WoW never tells an addon which icon a
  macro stores, only the one it shows, and the guess MacroForge made from
  the spell being cast moved with the game state (a castsequence step, a
  clause not active right now): the editor then wrote the shown icon back
  and the macro kept it. The editor now hands WoW no icon at all unless you
  picked one, the guess also recognises every spell and item the body
  names, and a set, a duplicate or a restored revision that carries a
  shown icon writes "?" instead.
- **Revisions**: a `#showtooltip` macro no longer gets a new revision each
  time the icon it shows changes.
- **Dev bridge** (`tools/bridge.sh`): finds the account that is logged in
  and the addon folder the client loads; the addon reloads by itself once
  the query ran.

Spell ranks on WoW Forever: the picker offers every rank you know.

- **Spell picker and autocomplete know ranks**: "Earth Shock" (the highest
  rank you know, with its rank under the name) and "Earth Shock(Rank 1)",
  "Earth Shock(Rank 2)" for the lower ones, each with its own tooltip. The
  list used to show the spell once per rank, all inserting the plain name
  and all showing the top rank. Searching "rank 1" finds them.
- **`/use Earth Shock(Rank 1)` is verified** against your spellbook (it was
  "Unverified"), and the detected-spells icons and the icon picker show
  that rank.
- **Flyouts, spells not learned yet and passives** are no longer offered
  by the picker; a spell listed in two spellbook tabs shows once.
- **Learning a spell** (a new rank, a trainer visit) refreshes the picker
  and the analysis without a reload.
- **Code colouring**: castsequence steps are checked one by one (the whole
  line used to turn orange), `reset=` has its own colour, and a space
  before a `;` no longer shifts the coloured overlay.
- A pasted macro is named after its spell without the "(Rank 1)".

Broken macros turn red, and one click fixes them.

- **Syntax checker**: a line whose [ ] or ; are broken turns the code box's
  frame and line number red, and a strip at the bottom of the box says what
  is wrong, with a Fix button when the intent is clear: conditions typed
  after the spell (`/target Boss[@mouseover]`), a missing `;` between two
  clauses, spaces instead of commas (`[combat mod:shift]`), a `[` never
  closed, a stray `]`, `[[`. One click fixes every mistake of the line
  that has a clear fix; ambiguous ones (`[known:Fire Blast Fire Blast`)
  are reported without a guess. Works for every command that takes
  conditions, not only /cast.
- **Unknown conditions** (`[noddead]`) are errors now, on every command that
  takes conditions (they were warnings, and only checked on /cast): Fix
  renames the typo to the closest condition (`[nodead]`) when it is clear.
- **Condition Builder** inserts at the start of the clause the cursor is
  in, never in the middle of a spell name.
- **Condition Builder** reads as three steps: who the spell goes on, the
  conditions that must all be true, and the result. Conditions are added one
  at a time (+ Add, X to remove) instead of five empty slots; hovering one,
  in the list or in its row, says what it checks. Insert stays greyed out
  while there is nothing to insert. Fixed: empty argument buttons showed
  next to unused slots.

# MacroForge

## [v7.5.0](https://github.com/kriffin/MacroForge/tree/v7.5.0) (2026-09-24)
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/kriffin/MacroForge/compare/v7.4.0...v7.5.0) [Previous Releases](https://github.com/kriffin/MacroForge/releases)

- release: 7.5.0  
    - Version 7.5.0, CHANGES section, languages with flags in the README and  
      the CurseForge page.  
    - The .toc carries the CurseForge project ID: with the CF\_API\_KEY secret,  
      the Release workflow now uploads to CurseForge by itself.  
- feat: Italian, Korean and Traditional Chinese locales  
- feat: German, Spanish (esES/esMX), Brazilian Portuguese, Russian and Simplified Chinese locales  
    CI now checks every locale file against enUS.  
- feat: clickable problems on Home, Ctrl+N remembers the scope, Duplicate opens the copy  
    - Home: the macros that need attention open on click, like the recent ones.  
    - Ctrl+N and Home's New button reuse the scope (character or account)  
      picked last time; the button's label says which.  
    - Duplicate names the copy ' (cp)' cut on characters, not bytes, and  
      opens it in the editor.  
- ci: let the release workflow create the GitHub release  
    v7.4.0 packaged fine but the packager got 403 'Resource not accessible by  
    integration': the default GITHUB\_TOKEN is read-only.
